title: Fate's Crossroads
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped into the next phase of the chess game as a Chess Player, the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye had quietly shifted from the level of rules to a deeper layer of the game—and that seemingly useless dead card in his hand might just be the key to breaking the deadlock.

text.content:
The crescent moon hung like a hook over the withered pines of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Chen Ji sat alone at the edge of the Cliff, his robes fluttering in the night wind. His gaze pierced through the heavy darkness, falling upon the faintly glowing fragment in his palm—the patterns of the third page of the Tianji Record were slowly flowing, as if some ancient pulse was awakening.

The message still echoed in his mind: Chen Nian's final warning, that 'older, more primitive existence' that had slumbered since the dawn of creation. This meant the enemy he faced was far more terrifying than the eye of the Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content:
Young Master, your heart is troubled.

Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul emerged from the Tianji Record, his illusory form even more faint than before, as if it might be scattered by the night wind at any moment. His voice was hoarse and low: 'The three-month deadline is a node in the Heavenly Dao's operation. When the heavens and earth transform and the rules loosen—it is both a shackle and an opportunity.'

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer. His spiritual sense sank deep into the Tianji Record, where that hazy gray fog still shrouded the image of Chen Nian. His sister's face was blurred to the point of near-oblivion, as if her existence itself was a denial of the Tianji Record's rules.

Was this interference from the Heavenly Fate Key, or deliberate concealment by that 'older existence'?

He slowly opened his eyes, a faint, cold smile curling at the corner of his lips. Whatever the case, Chen Ji was never one to wait passively for death.

dialogue.content:
Since three months later is the opportunity to break fate...

Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable certainty. He rose to his feet, dust falling from his robes: 'Then let them see whose hand moves upon this chessboard.'

text.content:
Just then, a cold aura swept in from the distance. Chen Ji's brow lifted slightly, talismans in his sleeve quietly glowing—the unique Demonic Path mark of Ye Qing.

A pitch-black Jade Slip pierced through the air, landing steadily in his palm. The surface of the Jade Slip flowed with eerie dark purple patterns, emanating a faint aura of the netherworld.

Chen Ji probed it with his spiritual sense, and moments later, his eyes flashed with sharp light.

dialogue.content:
In three months, the heavens and earth will transform. The Demonic Path Commander will personally descend to the mortal realm.

Ye Qing's voice emerged from the Jade Slip, cool and clear, yet carrying a rare gravity: 'The Holy Sect has mobilized all its hidden pieces—they are determined to win this war. Chen Ji, does our agreement still hold?'

text.content:
Chen Ji gripped the Jade Slip, his knuckles tightening slightly.

The Demonic Path Commander—a legendary existence, with cultivation said to have reached the edge of Ascension, ruling over millions of miles of the Demonic Path, causing even the Three Great Sects to temporarily retreat. Such a figure appearing suddenly in the mortal world—there must be a shocking conspiracy behind it.

And the news from Ling Yuan coincided perfectly with what Ye Qing had said.

He suddenly laughed, that笑意 cold and sharp: 'Interesting, it seems this chess game is more complicated than I imagined.'

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing, three months from now, on the night when the heavens and earth transform.

Chen Ji's voice wascalm得近乎漠然, as if discussing today's weather: 'You and I join forces to fight the true enemy. Before then—each takes what they need, mutual non-interference.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proposed the possibility of cooperation, Chen Ji must express his stance in response.

choices.text: Accept cooperation, jointly seek to break the局
choices.description: Formally ally with Ye Qing, join forces during the three-month deadline to oppose the true enemy. The risk lies in the sensitive identity of the Demonic Path Saint, easy to be discovered.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the connection with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Gain the ability to conceal the aura of the Tianji Record through the Demonic Path's mist
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, will become the target of all

dialogue.content:
Very well.

Ye Qing's answer was brief and decisive, yet carried an undetectable hint of relief: 'On the night of the three-month deadline, when the heavens and earth transform. Before then, each of us makes our preparations. At that time—' Her voice paused, 'I will shield you from the Holy Sect's pursuit.'

choices.memory_label: 与魔道圣女达成三月之约

choices.text: Keep options open, quietly observe the situation
choices.description: Not rush into an alliance, first observe Ye Qing's sincerity and the movements within the Demonic Path. Steady but may miss the opportunity for deep cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: May lose the shelter of the Demonic Path's mist
choices.visible_reward: Maintain freedom of action, avoid being bound
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may turn to seek other allies

dialogue.content:
...Very well then.

Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, her voice carrying a hint of amusement: 'Chen Ji, you are indeed as cautious as the rumors say. At the three-month deadline, I await your answer.' The light on the Jade Slip gradually dimmed, but did not completely fade—she was waiting.

text.content:
The night wind grew cold, Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the cliff's edge, gazing at the faint dawn breaking over the eastern horizon.

The three-month deadline, the transformation of heaven and earth. This was both an opportunity to break free from shackles and a trap bristling with thorns.

He closed his eyes, the patterns of the Tianji Record slowly emerging in his mind. The ability to foresee the future activated once more—not passively waiting for fate's arrangement, but actively seeking that third path.

dialogue.content:
Submit to the chess game, overturn the chessboard, become the Chess Player...

Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice low and cold: 'Three paths, each one a deadlock. But within a deadlock, there must be flaws.' He opened his eyes, his gaze deep as an abyss: 'Since the Heavenly Dao wishes me to dance within this chess game, then let its wish be granted—in this dance, I will lay out my own chess pieces.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji must decide how to act within the three-month deadline.

choices.text: Obedient on the surface, scheming in the shadows
choices.description: Accept the Heavenly Dao's mission to gain trust, while secretly seeking a way to break the局. A perfect strategy of playing dumb, but it requires enduring the pain of the shackles.
choices.visible_cost: Enduring the pain of shackles, temporarily restrained
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Heavenly Dao's trust, unlocking more content of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The shackles may backfire at a critical moment

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his hand, and the ethereal light of the Tianji Record condensed into an illusory contract pattern in his palm. This was the mark of the Heavenly Dao, an embodiment of shackles.

Without hesitation, he pressed his palm against the pattern - an instant piercing pain shot through his entire body, as if thousands of fine needles were wandering through his meridians.

Yet a faint, indifferent smile lingered at the corner of his lips.

Pain? Had Chen Ji not endured countless pains before?

choices.text: Quietly accumulating strength, waiting for the right moment
choices.description: Neither fully accepting the mission nor openly resisting, but using this time to secretly accumulate strength, connect with allies, and find the key to breaking the局.
choices.visible_reward: Retaining more trump cards, preparing more thoroughly to break the局
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao may mete out punishment ahead of schedule

text.content:
Chen Ji did not rush to activate that contract pattern. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze profound as an abyss.

Being obedient on the surface could indeed gain trust, but once the shackles were imposed, they would cling like flesh-burrowing maggots. He needed time - time to contact Ye Qing, time to find clues about his sister, time to fathom the secrets of that 'far more ancient existence.'

"Three months..." he murmured softly, "That will be enough."

choices.text: Taking the initiative to seek a third path
choices.description: Not following the rules set by the Heavenly Dao, but proactively searching for flaws left by that 'far more ancient existence.' May gain unexpected fortune, but the risk is immense.
choices.visible_cost: May anger the Heavenly Dao, exposing intentions prematurely
choices.visible_reward: May discover a shocking secret, obtaining the key to breaking the局
choices.risk_hint: Once failed, will face dual pressure from both the Heavenly Dao and the ancient existence

dialogue.content:
Young master, this move is too dangerous.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul anxiously manifested, his voice carrying rare anxiety: "That 'far more ancient existence' slumbers since the world's beginning - its might is far beyond our comprehension. Recklessly reaching out, one may risk their life!"

text.content:
Dawn's first light emerged, golden rays piercing through the clouds, spilling across the blue tiles of the Tianqing Sect.

Chen Ji withdrew his thoughts, turning to gaze at the familiar sect below the mountain. The Servant Disciples' quarters lay quietly in the morning mist, undisturbed, as if the turbulence of this chaotic world had nothing to do with them.

But he knew - this tranquility was merely a facade before the storm.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji.

An ancient and majestic voice traveled through the void, Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly - it was Ling Yuan's transmission.

The old sect master's tone was as gentle as always: "In three days, meet me at the Sect Council Hall. There is an important matter to discuss." The voice paused, then added: "Regarding the shackles on your body... perhaps I can be of some assistance."

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, his knuckles unconsciously tightening.

Ling Yuan proactively mentioning the shackles - this was by no means goodwill. What was this old fox scheming? Did he want to seize the opportunity to plant some hidden mechanism on him, or did he have other designs?

In any case, when they met, he must be on full alert.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slightly bowed, his voice respectful and humble: "Disciple obeys."

After the transmission dissipated, he straightened up, a playful arc curling at the corner of his lips. Ling Yuan wanted to help? Hmph, such words might fool others, but to trick Chen Ji...

He walked toward the mountain, the morning light stretching his shadow long.

"In three days, I can just see what chess this old fox has laid out."

choice.prompt: Faced with Ling Yuan's invitation, Chen Ji must decide how to respond.

choices.text: Turn the plan to one's advantage, draw out the snake
choices.description: On the surface, he appears obedient and accepts the invitation, but secretly he prepares contingencies, waiting for Ling Yuan to reveal a weakness before delivering a fatal strike. A classic tiger-dressing-as-pig strategy.
choices.visible_cost: Needs to continuously maintain the useless persona, suppressing his true strength.
choices.visible_reward: Opportunity to grasp Ling Yuan's的把柄.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely深藏不露, may反将他一军.

text.content: Chen Ji walked along, continuously calculating the situation three days later in his mind. Ling Yuan wanted to make an example of him, nothing more than using chains to control him, or seeking the secrets of the Tianji Record. But this old thing doesn't know—his Chen Ji's greatest specialty is making others believe they've won. When the truth is revealed that day, Ling Yuan's expression will surely be magnificent.

choices.memory_label: 决定将计就计对付凌渊

choices.description: Use these three days to connect with allies and prepare contingencies, ensuring there are no loopholes when confronting Ling Yuan. Safe but time-consuming.
choices.visible_cost: Dividing attention may cause missing certain opportunities.
choices.visible_reward: More confident when confronting Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: The moment Chen Ji returned to the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, a dark purple communication talisman silently flew out the window—a secret path to Ye Qing. "Three days later, Tianqing Sect Council Hall, Ling Yuan is acting abnormally. If something happens to me, the Demonic Path Mist activates immediately." The talisman transformed into flowing light and vanished in the morning dawn, while Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the bed, beginning a new round of calculations.

choices.memory_label: 暗中联络夜清作为后手

text.content: The morning mist gradually dispersed, and the bells of Tianqing Sect rang out slowly. Chen Ji rose and pushed open the window lattice, the clear mountain breeze brushing against his face. He gazed at the distant continuous halls, at those cultivators running about for cultivation, for immortality, for power—the depths of his eyes flickered with a cold intent. Whether Heaven's Will or Ling Yuan, they both wanted to use him as a chess piece. But what they didn't know was—the true chess player has always been outside the game. "Three months' deadline..." he murmured softly, "this game, Chen Ji accepts."

The mountain wind whistled past, lifting a corner of his robe. Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, turning his attention back to the faintly glowing fragment in his palm. The patterns of the Tianji Record continued to flow slowly, as if narrating some ancient prophecy. And in the depths of that Tianji Record, the gray mist obscuring Chen Nian's face seemed several shades denser than yesterday...

dialogue.content: Nian'er... wait for your brother. Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice tender in a way that seemed foreign from his usual self. The next instant, that trace of softness had already been replaced by coldness. He turned and walked out of the servants' quarters, heading toward the Mission Hall. Whether chains or chess games, to break them one must first become stronger. And he, Chen Ji, has never lacked the determination or means to grow stronger.

text.content: When Chen Ji's figure vanished at the end of the Mountain Path, a gray messenger pigeon quietly landed on the windowsill of the servants' quarters. Tied to the pigeon's leg was a small Jade Slip with only a few brief words: "Three months' deadline, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key will appear." At the signature was a blurred seal—identical to the final message left by Chen Ling. Outside Tianqing Sect, in a certain hidden valley, a girl in gray robes lifted her head, gazing toward Tianqing Sect in the distance. Her eyes were empty and dazed, as if looking at something, yet also looking at nothing. "Brother..." Her voice was very soft, as if it might be scattered by the wind at any moment.
